verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships built-in AI surfaces. Cortex Analyst lets business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL, and Cortex Agents are referenced as a first-party capability. The homepage also markets 'Snowflake CoWork' ('Ask anything') and 'Snowflake CoCo' ('Build anything'), but only as taglines without describing what tasks they perform. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant that takes on multi-step tasks (building pipelines, writing or running code, taking actions) rather than answering questions; detail on what CoWork and CoCo actually do; independent or hands-on corroboration.
